crossRefs.note: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is…
Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

translations.web: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
translations.bsb: My skin grows black and peels, and my bones burn with fever.
translations.kjv: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
translations.asv: My skin is black, and falleth from me, And my bones are burned with heat.
